_comment: Cross-project research intake for RiftReader2. This file is STRICT JSON (not JSONC); keys prefixed _comment are explanatory and may be ignored by consumers. Read-only evidence map: NOT executable instructions, not a runtime connector, not a grant of new game input, and not proof of current telemetry.
purpose: Source-linked intake of reusable research from RRE, REA-Lab1, REA tooling, Rift API, LuaPadModern and adjacent projects; recover RR2 freshness safely and focus new discovery.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Re-read current RR2 git/status and exact host/guest process PID, start, executable SHA, VM identity, addon installation hashes, changed service identity.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: All pins contemporaneous and internally consistent; changed build or process invalidates historical addresses/nonces.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Inspect authenticated per-lab controller, receiver and reader liveness, addon session, controller queue and foreground. Prefer RR2's existing on-demand helpers only where authorized.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: Single controller owner, ready/disarmed, no unqualified takeover. Process existence alone is not enough.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Bind one new reader nonce to current addon/receiver through the existing reviewed exclusive console path if rebind is actually required.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: Current nonce, session, player, epoch and source are explicitly matched; never reuse November 1 nonces. This document does not authorize performing input.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Require strictly advancing receiver and addon sequence/time stamps and fresh XYZ, reject Win32-299/anchor failures and the prior stalled-addon-sequence pattern.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: Configured 480-second strict observer passes on one current epoch with acceptable receipt gaps, stable identity and adequate expiry margin.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Only after fresh gates pass, a single lab owner may perform an independently approved bounded state change with before/after native plus API/UI evidence and independent STOP/release.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: Changed-state verification, exact outcome/effect and independent cleanup; no silent automatic re-arm or action extrapolation.

ordered_recovery_gates.check: Fully terminate and relaunch RIFT only under separate authorized workflow; resolve owner, data locator and reader in NEW process epoch.
ordered_recovery_gates.pass: Fresh data recovers on new PID/start, not merely after /reloadui or relog.

stop_rules: No current source nonce/reader or stale addon publication -> do offline analysis, not gameplay.
Controller lease, GUI desktop quarantine, foreground or approval uncertainty -> stop and ask owner.
Build mismatch or changed process -> invalidate live RVAs/pointers and rebuild exact source pins.
An installed addon hash match never qualifies a live feed.
A failed/expired trial is not evidence of goal arrival, spellcast acceptance, native field meaning or freshness.

field_guide._comment: These labels define how a future RR2 agent or importer should interpret transfer records; this is an inventory, not a schema for direct importer execution.
field_guide.priority: P0 immediate high-value blocker or canonical intake; P1 next qualified research; P2 useful when predecessors satisfied; P3 optional/deferred; P4 research-only.
field_guide.source_ids: Refer to IDs in source_registry; a missing source SHA means not independently pinned and must be rehashed before promotion.
field_guide.state: Use one of evidence_semantics.transfer_states; no state automatically grants current runtime proof.
field_guide.proof_tier: G0 source byte; G1 API/UI or offline description; G2 qualified historical runtime observation; G3 exact-build static native; G4 combined end-to-end. A high static tier does not override a low live tier.
field_guide.supported: Narrowest evidence-backed claim; interpret literally and retain timestamps/build limits.
field_guide.not_supported: Explicit false inference boundaries; these prevent automated status promotion.
field_guide.next_verification: A proposed future research/validation step, not a runnable command or action approval.
field_guide.source_build_sha256: Required for native RVAs; old RRE NAV SHA and current SHA differ. Do not port offsets by name or numerical equality.
field_guide.commit: Observed repository HEAD for a tracked source path, not proof the file was introduced by that commit. Null for untracked files.
field_guide.sha256: Exact file bytes when populated; a null value is intentional and requires fresh hashing.
field_guide.observed: Historical observation and receipt, not necessarily current process identity.
field_guide.currentness: No source listed here is a substitute for current PID/start/reader nonce/addon epoch/player/role and independent sequence advancement.

integration_guardrails._comment: Rules for a consumer converting this broad manifest into RR2's strict discovery-record-set/1 format or research tasks.
source_verification: Resolve repo/path exactly; read current file and compute SHA256
Verify it matches the registry value when non-null
For tracked sources, check expected Git commit/HEAD ancestry and any dirty state
For untracked sources, do not cite observed HEAD as containing file bytes
For native RVA claim, verify 64-hex target PE SHA and exact original instruction bytes
normalization: Preserve original IDs, variant source and role; do not use name as primary key
Preserve omitted vs false vs zero vs invalid field statuses
Separate source-time, host-receive-time and export-time clocks
Retain current process and addon identity only from a fresh contemporaneous receipt
Map source static proof G0/G3 independently of RR2's live G2 proof
avoid_duplicate_work: Use existing RR2 discovery adapter and JSON/CSV/JSONL export; do not create new service
Use existing RR2 guarded controllers and publisher rather than copying RRE/REA controls
Read RRE's accepted SC604 graph before native rescan; do not rerun timed-out whole-program REA imports
Use bounded Capstone/iced-x86/Ghidra function starts for static leads
Review RRE and REA-Lab1 claims separately; no cross-project writes or automatic model/agent launch
integration_guardrails.authorization_boundary: This inventory authorizes no game input, addon reload, process attach, automation, VM control, network publishing, source edit or protected lease reset.
